hero.title: Welcome to BETTERGOV.PH
hero.lede: The volunteer run portal of the Republic of the Philippines. Find information, access government services, stay updated with the latest news about the Philippines.
hero.prompt: What do you need from the government?

items.label: Travel & Identification
items.desc: Passports, visas, NBI clearance, driver's license.

items.label: Taxes & Revenue
items.desc: BIR filing, TIN, business permits, customs.

items.label: Social Security
items.desc: SSS, GSIS, Pag-IBIG, pensions and benefits.

items.label: Education
items.desc: DepEd, CHED, TESDA, scholarships, school forms.

items.label: Labor & Employment
items.desc: DOLE, OWWA, POEA, work permits, OFW.

movement.label: The BetterGov movement
movement.title: Built by volunteers, in the open
movement.lede: BetterGov.ph is a volunteer-driven civic technology and open-source movement making Philippine government data accessible, understandable, and actionable.
movement.body: Developers, researchers and organizers build this portal and other free public tools in the open, and anyone can join.

stats.contributors: contributors: developers, researchers, organizers and more
stats.tools: free public tools, from the budget portal to Juris.ph

movement.source: Figures from about.bettergov.ph, as of 16 October 2026

transparency.label: Where public money goes
